title: Riftn Has Acquired Fan.site. Here’s What Happens to BJ
html:
Fan.site began as a community-led fork of Riftn. We’ve now acquired the Fan.site ecosystem, including all its assets and intellectual property. All team members and contributors who were allocated tokens have either been bought out or had their token allocation agreements cancelled.

What BJ holders can claim

When $RIFT launches, eligible BJ investors can claim 100 $RIFT for every BJ token they hold. The full allocation will be available at launch, with no lock-up or vesting.

The planned initial listing price is $0.001 per $RIFT, with a total supply of 8 billion $RIFT. Any change to those terms would be announced and implemented through governance proposals. We’ll announce the listing date separately.

Register before 7 December for the bonus

If you bought BJ in the presale or on the open market, register at Riftn.com before 7 December to qualify for a substantial bonus on top of your airdrops. We’ll confirm the bonus amount and its vesting schedule closer to the $RIFT listing.

What you can use today

Every feature and token utility we promised for Fan.site is already live on Riftn. You can open an account today and start using Riftn’s in-app currency to tip creators and unlock content while we prepare for the listing.

You can manage access to mature content through your account settings on the web and in the mobile apps. Explicit pornography is excluded from public feeds in the App Store and Google Play versions under Apple’s content guidelines and Google Play’s content policy.

Thank you to everyone who backed Fan.site, helped build the community and gave us time to get here. We’re looking forward to welcoming you to Riftn.
md:
Fan.site began as a [community-led fork of Riftn](/guides/decentralization-in-practice-the-fansite-fork-story). We’ve now acquired the Fan.site ecosystem, including all its assets and intellectual property. All team members and contributors who were allocated tokens have either been bought out or had their token allocation agreements cancelled.

## What BJ holders can claim

When $RIFT launches, eligible BJ investors can claim **100 $RIFT for every BJ token they hold**. The full allocation will be available at launch, with no lock-up or vesting.

The planned initial listing price is **$0.001 per $RIFT**, with a total supply of **8 billion $RIFT**. Any change to those terms would be announced and implemented through governance proposals. We’ll announce the listing date separately.

## Register before 7 December for the bonus

If you bought BJ in the presale or on the open market, [register at Riftn.com](https://riftn.com) **before 7 December** to qualify for a substantial bonus on top of your airdrops. We’ll confirm the bonus amount and its vesting schedule closer to the $RIFT listing.

## What you can use today

Every feature and token utility we promised for Fan.site is already live on Riftn. You can open an account today and start using [Riftn’s in-app currency](/docs/token/overview) to tip creators and unlock content while we prepare for the listing.

You can manage access to mature content through your account settings on the web and in the mobile apps. Explicit pornography is excluded from public feeds in the App Store and Google Play versions under [Apple’s content guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/) and [Google Play’s content policy](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/9878810).

Thank you to everyone who backed Fan.site, helped build the community and gave us time to get here. We’re looking forward to welcoming you to Riftn.
